title: 第3章  周皇：要不就给他试试？
slug: 开局自曝系统父皇举国助我娶妻
content_zh:
御书房内，死寂无声。
赵道霆的呼吸都停了。
一本通体泛着淡金光泽的典籍，就那么凭空出现在赵辰安的掌心。
没有储物法宝的灵力波动，没有丝毫空间涟漪。
就像是……神迹。
赵道霆一生征战，身为大周帝王，自认心如铁石，此刻指尖却传来一阵冰凉的麻意。
他那双阅尽世间沧桑的眼眸，第一次出现了无法掌控的收缩。
这不是神通。
这是他无法理解的法则！
《大道天衍经》。
仅仅是封面上那五个古字，就让赵道霆的神魂一阵刺痛，仿佛在仰望一片无法揣度的星空。
这逆子，从哪里得来的这东西？
还是能将整个大周王朝拖入深渊的滔天大祸？
属于帝王的威压轰然降临，却因为主人心绪的剧烈波动而显得不稳。
赵道霆死死盯着赵辰安，声音是从牙缝里挤出来的。
“此物，何来？”
他第一个念头，不是占有，是恐惧。
能拿出这等物品的存在，碾死他这个小小的“王朝”帝王，比碾死一只蚂蚁还简单。
自己的儿子，平日里斗鸡走狗，怎么会沾染上这等恐怖的因果？
莫不是被哪个万年老怪当成了棋子？

面对父皇几乎要噬人的目光，赵辰安的脸上却恰到好处地浮现出茫然与激动。
他摊开手，仿佛自己也无法解释。
“父皇，儿臣不知。”
“昨夜大婚后，儿臣梦入混沌，有宏大之音告知，儿臣激活了上古大能遗留的传承。”
赵辰安按照早已演练无数遍的说辞，语气真诚。
“那传承规则……很奇特。只要儿臣迎娶的妻子资质越是绝佳，诞下的子嗣越是不凡，便能获得越丰厚的传承奖赏。”
“这本功法，便是儿臣醒来后，脑中多出的第一份赏赐！儿臣不敢隐瞒，立刻前来禀告父皇！”
说完，他一脸坦荡地看着赵道霆，像个第一时间向家长献宝的孩子。
御书房内，落针可闻。
赵道霆的目光如刀，一寸寸剐过赵辰安的脸，试图找出哪怕一丝一毫的心虚。
只有坦诚，和尚未从天降横财中回神的懵懂。
“荒唐！”
赵道霆勃然大怒，一掌拍在御案上，坚硬的紫檀木应声浮现一道裂纹。
“上古传承？娶妻变强？赵辰安！你当朕是三岁孩童吗！”
帝王的怒火，是试探。
他要看看，自己的儿子，在这滔天压力下，是否会露出马脚。
然而，赵辰安身形笔直，不闪不避。
“父皇，儿臣所言，句句属实，苍天可鉴。”
他就那么坦然地迎接着赵道霆的怒火，目光清澈，没有半分动摇。
看着儿子这副“我没撒谎，信不信由你”的模样，赵道霆心头的怒火，竟诡异地消散了。

他了解这个儿子。
顽劣是真，却没胆子在他面前如此面不改色地撒下弥天大谎。
难道……
这个荒诞到极点的念头，让赵道霆的心脏狠狠一抽。
他的目光，重新落回那本金色典籍。
他伸出手，动作缓慢而凝重。
指尖触及封面的瞬间，赵道霆闷哼一声，竟踉跄着后退了半步！
他的神魂，在哀鸣！在颤栗！
仅仅是触碰，就让他这个四极境圆满的强者，感受到了来自生命层次的绝对压制！
是真的！
赵道霆眼中的惊骇再也无法掩饰，他双手并用，将那本薄薄的典籍捧了起来。
入手，却重若山岳！
他颤抖着翻开第一页。
《轮海卷》。
精妙！绝伦！比大周皇室的镇国地品功法《玄水真经》，高明了不止一个维度！
他急速向后翻。
《道宫卷》！
《四极卷》！
《化龙卷》！
当他的手指，停在最后一卷的开篇时，他的呼吸，彻底停滞了。

《仙台卷》！
从仙台一层到仙台九层，通往圣人至境的完整道路，就这么清清楚楚地展现在他的面前！
这不是什么天品功法！
这他妈是足以让不朽圣地血流成河的天品传承！
周国皇室传承的地品功法已是极限，让他止步于四极，前路断绝。
他本以为此生无望，大周也将在他手中继续沉沦。
可现在！
一条通天大道，就摆在他的面前！
赵道霆猛地合上典籍，胸膛剧烈起伏，看向赵辰安的眼神，再无半分帝王的审视和猜忌。
那是一种凡人仰望神迹的眼神！
震惊，狂喜，最终化为一丝他自己都未曾察觉的……敬畏！
他信了。
除了真正的仙缘，世间再无任何解释！
凭空造物，直指圣人的无上宝典……
自己这个最不成器的逆子，撞上了何等逆天的造化！
而这份造化的钥匙，竟然是……娶老婆？
赵道霆的思维，因为这个结论而出现了片刻的空白。
就在这时，赵辰安的声音再次响起。
“父皇，儿臣天生废体，无法开辟苦海。此等神物在儿臣手中，是明珠蒙尘。”
他对着赵道霆，郑重一拜，额头触地。

“今日，儿臣将此法献给父皇！愿助父皇打破桎梏，君临天下，带领我大周，万世不朽！”
这一拜，这一席话，如神雷天降，狠狠劈在赵道霆的心头。
他看着匍匐在地的儿子，这个他曾以为只能当个富贵闲人了此一生的儿子，心中五味杂陈。
哪怕是帝王心术，此刻也无法控制那翻江倒海的情绪。
赵道霆胸膛剧烈起伏，却发不出任何声音，只是走下御阶，亲手将赵辰安扶起。
他连说了三个“好”字，声音嘶哑。
“辰安，有你这份心，父皇……很欣慰。”
赵道霆拍了拍儿子的肩膀，声音终于恢复了帝王的沉稳与决断。
“此事，是你我父子二人，是我大周王朝最大的秘密。”
“从今日起，烂在肚子里，绝不可让第三人知晓，明白吗？”
“儿臣明白！”
赵辰安再次行礼，干脆利落地退出了御书房。
厚重的殿门缓缓关闭。
御书房内，再次只剩下赵道霆一人。
他站在原地，如同一尊雕塑。
良久，他缓缓低头，看着手中那本薄薄的，却承载着一个王朝未来的金色典籍。
“迎娶的妻子资质越是绝佳……能获得的传承奖励就越丰厚……”
天狼部落之女，便奖励了如此逆天的功法。
那若是……天赋更加优质的女子呢？
赵道霆的呼吸，渐渐变得粗重。

大周，困于“王朝”之名，已有三百年！
破局之机，竟在这个最不成器的儿子身上！
他缓缓走回御案，坐上那张冰冷的龙椅，将《大道天衍经》珍而重之地放在面前。
他的手指，在桌面上无意识地敲击着。
许久，敲击声戛然而止。
黑暗中，一声极轻的低语响起，带着不容置疑的决断。
“那……就试试？”
content_en:
In the imperial study room, there was deathly silence.
Zhao Daoting's breathing stopped.
A book with a light golden luster appeared in Zhao Chenan's palm out of thin air.
There is no spiritual power fluctuation from the stored magic weapon, and there is no ripple in the space.
It's like...a miracle.
Zhao Daoting has been fighting all his life. As the emperor of the Great Zhou Dynasty, he thought that his heart was as stone as stone, but at this moment, he felt a cold numbness on his fingertips.
His eyes, which had seen all the vicissitudes of the world, shrank uncontrollably for the first time.
This is not magical power.
This is a law he cannot understand!
"Dao Tian Yan Jing".
Just the five ancient characters on the cover made Zhao Daoting's soul sting, as if he was looking up at an incomprehensible starry sky.
Where did this traitor get this thing?
Or is it a catastrophic disaster that can drag the entire Zhou Dynasty into the abyss?
The pressure of the emperor came suddenly, but it seemed unstable because of the violent fluctuations in the master's mood.
Zhao Daoting stared at Zhao Chenan, his voice coming out from between his teeth.
"Where did this thing come from?"
His first thought was not possession, but fear.
Being able to produce such items, crushing him, a little "dynasty" emperor, would be easier than crushing an ant.
How could his own son, who was usually a lackey in cockfighting, be contaminated by such horrific consequences?
Could it be that he was used as a pawn by some thousand-year-old monster?
Facing his father's almost gnawing gaze, Zhao Chenan's face showed just the right amount of confusion and excitement.
He spread his hands, as if he couldn't explain it.
"Father, my son and I don't know."
"After the wedding last night, I dreamed of falling into chaos, and a majestic voice told me that I had activated the inheritance left by the ancient power."
Zhao Chenan followed the words he had rehearsed countless times and sounded sincere.
"The inheritance rules... are very strange. As long as the wife you marry has excellent qualifications, and the more extraordinary the children you give birth to, the richer inheritance rewards you will receive."
"This skill is the first reward that comes to my mind after I wake up! I don't dare to hide it and come immediately to report it to my father!"
After saying that, he looked at Zhao Daoting with a magnanimous expression, like a child who immediately presented a treasure to his parents.
In the royal study room, you can hear a needle drop.
Zhao Daoting's gaze was like a knife, slicing across Zhao Chenan's face inch by inch, trying to find even the slightest hint of guilt.
There is only frankness and ignorance that has not yet recovered from the windfall.
"Absurd!"
Zhao Daoting was furious and slapped the imperial case with his palm, causing a crack to appear on the hard rosewood.
"Ancient inheritance? Get a wife and become stronger? Zhao Chenan! Do you think I am a three-year-old child!"
The anger of an emperor is a temptation.
He wanted to see if his son would show his flaws under this tremendous pressure.
However, Zhao Chenan's figure was straight and he did not dodge or evade.
"Father, what I have said is true, and the heavens can learn from it."
He faced Zhao Daoting's anger so calmly, his eyes were clear and he didn't waver in the slightest.
Seeing his son's "I'm not lying, it's up to you to believe it or not" look, the anger in Zhao Daoting's heart eerily dissipated.
He knew this son.
It was true that she was naughty, but she didn't have the guts to tell such a big lie in front of him with such a straight face.
Could it be...
This extremely absurd idea made Zhao Daoting's heart twitch.
His eyes fell back on the golden book.
He stretched out his hand, his movements slow and solemn.
The moment his fingertips touched the cover, Zhao Daoting groaned and staggered back half a step!
His soul is wailing! Trembling!
Just a touch made him, a strong man with perfect four-pole realm, feel the absolute suppression from the life level!
It's true!
The horror in Zhao Daoting's eyes could no longer be concealed. He used both hands to hold up the thin classic.
Once you get it, it’s as heavy as a mountain!
Trembling, he turned to the first page.
"The Wheel of the Sea".
Exquisite! Unparalleled! CompareThe royal family of the Great Zhou Dynasty's "Xuan Shui Zhen Jing", a state-leveling technique, is brilliant in more than one dimension!
He rolled backwards rapidly.
"Tao Palace Scroll"!
"Siji Volume"!
"The Dragon Scroll"!
When his fingers stopped at the beginning of the last volume, his breathing completely stopped.
"Sendai Scroll"!
From the first floor of Sendai to the ninth floor of Sendai, the complete road leading to the saint's realm was clearly displayed in front of him!
This is not a heavenly skill!
This is a heavenly inheritance that is enough to make the Immortal Holy Land flow with blood!
The earth-level skills inherited by the Zhou royal family have reached their limit, stopping him at the four extremes and cutting off the way forward.
He originally thought that there was no hope in this life, and Da Zhou would continue to perish in his hands.
But now!
A road leading to the sky was right in front of him!
Zhao Daoting suddenly closed the book, his chest heaving violently, and his eyes looked at Zhao Chenan, without any trace of imperial scrutiny or suspicion.
That is the look in the eyes of a mortal looking up to a miracle!
The shock, ecstasy, finally turned into a trace of awe that he himself was not aware of!
He believed it.
Apart from true immortality, there is no explanation in the world!
Created out of thin air, pointing directly to the supreme treasure of the saint...
I, the most incompetent and rebellious son, had encountered such an unfavorable fate!
And the key to this destiny is... getting a wife?
Zhao Daoting's thinking went blank for a moment because of this conclusion.
At this moment, Zhao Chenan's voice sounded again.
"Father, I was born with a useless body and cannot open up the sea of suffering. In my hands, these divine objects are like pearls covered in dust."
He bowed solemnly to Zhao Daoting and touched his forehead to the ground.
"Today, I dedicate this method to my father! I am willing to help my father break the shackles, rule the world, and lead me, the Great Zhou Dynasty, to be immortal forever!"
This bow and these words were like divine thunder falling from the sky, striking Zhao Daoting's heart hard.
He looked at his son lying on the ground, the son who he once thought could only spend his whole life as a wealthy and idle man, with mixed feelings in his heart.
Even the emperor's mental skills can't control the overwhelming emotions at this moment.
Zhao Daoting's chest rose and fell violently, but he couldn't make any sound. He just walked down the imperial steps and helped Zhao Chenan up with his own hands.
He said "good" three times in a row, his voice hoarse.
"Chen An, my father is... very happy to have your heart."
Zhao Daoting patted his son on the shoulder, and his voice finally regained the composure and determination of an emperor.
"This matter is between you and me, father and son. It is the biggest secret of our Great Zhou Dynasty."
"From today onwards, no third person can know about the rot in your stomach, do you understand?"
"My son understands!"
Zhao Chenan saluted again and exited the imperial study room neatly.
The heavy palace door slowly closed.
In the imperial study room, only Zhao Daoting was left alone again.
He stood there like a sculpture.
For a long time, he slowly lowered his head and looked at the thin golden book in his hand that held the future of a dynasty.
"The more excellent the qualifications of the wife you marry...the more generous inheritance rewards you can get..."
The daughter of the Tianlang tribe rewarded such a heaven-defying skill.
What if...it's a woman with better talent?
Zhao Daoting's breathing gradually became heavier.
The Great Zhou Dynasty has been trapped in the name of "dynasty" for three hundred years!
The opportunity to break the situation lies with this most ineffective son!
He slowly walked back to the imperial desk, sat on the cold dragon chair, and placed the precious "Dao Tian Yan Jing" in front of him.
His fingers tapped unconsciously on the table.
After a long time, the knocking sound stopped suddenly.
In the darkness, a very soft whisper sounded, carrying an unquestionable decision.
"Then... just give it a try?"
